title: WaterColor 5 Beachside | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front Location in WaterColor with Panoramic Gulf Views, Community Pools, Access To Beach Club, and Complimentary Bikes
description_expanded: Description: WaterColor 5 Beachside by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor Address: 1848 County Hwy 30A E, Unit 5 Details: WaterColor 5 Beachside is a Gulf-front luxury 30A rental with spectacular Gulf views, a freshly updated interior with new décor, and a hard-to-beat location. This two-story, four-bedroom WaterColor retreat offers nearly 3,000 square feet of beautifully refreshed living space, blending coastal style with elevated comfort. Guests can spend long days at the WaterColor Beach Club, take an afternoon dip in the community pool, and end the night watching the sun set over the Gulf. When you’re ready to explore, WaterColor and neighboring Seaside are just a short walk or bike ride away, offering incredible dining, shopping, and local charm. Perfectly positioned near both beach access and the community pool, WaterColor 5 Beachside delivers the best of 30A living—whether you’re enjoying the sugar-white sand, browsing local boutiques, or indulging in unforgettable meals, this beachfront escape will not disappoint. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Decor updates completed May 2026! -Gulf Front Location -Panoramic Gulf Views -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 10 Yards -Parking Spaces: 2 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 8 and Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Gulf Front Community Pool -Steps from the WaterColor Beach Club and shops and restaurants at WaterColor and Seaside WaterColor Neighborhood Amenities: -Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. -WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. -A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community -Bike Community -Award-Winning Tennis Facilities -Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining -Nearby State Parks and Preserves -4 Swimming Pools Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bed / 3 Bath Townhome First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunk Sets with Shared Bath (Shower) Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 4: (1) Queen Bed & Twin/Twin Bunk with Shared Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room / Laundry Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: -Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. -This home is located in the WaterColor community, if you would like to rent a golf cart for your reservation this can only be done through The Electric Cart Company. We encourage you to contact The Electric Cart Company prior to your arrival as they will only issue 60 golf cart permits throughout WaterColor at any given time. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
